addr: 2nd Main Rd, S.T. Bed, 1st Block Koramangala, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

rev.t: Attended a Saturday night event at Concept 01 and I’ve honestly never seen anything like this in Bangalore. The huge warehouse-style space instantly transported me to Berlin. Amazing vibe, great sound, and an incredible artist performance overall. Would absolutely love to come back and check out more Saturdays at Concept 01.

Incredible concept. I initially checked it out for the events, but the membership packages for creators are actually crazy value for money. Getting access to a full studio, ghost production support, and networking for that yearly rate is a no-brainer for anyone trying to take their music career seriously. Great team, great space.
Concept01 is more than just a place, it’s an experience The attention to the overall vibe and atmosphere really makes it stand out If you’re into good spaces and good energy, you’ll appreciate this
